plugins.label: Chat RCON
plugins.description: Lets referees run the Referee-Allowed Commands and admins anything but the Admin-Denied Commands from chat with !rcon <command>. Takes over the stock !rcon while enabled, and every use is written to the server log.

plugins.label: Match Restore
plugins.description: Saves the state of a running match (players with their position, velocity and view direction, items, timers and the match clock) and puts it back later, or restores a moment from a recorded .qlmatch pack, with the admin command !restore. Needs the minqlxtended runtime and the restore/ folder, which downloads with it.

plugins.label: match_restore helper
plugins.description: Helper of match_restore.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Live Telemetry
plugins.description: Sends live match data (positions, stats, item pickups, match events) from this instance to ql-stats-hub through the host's telemetry relay. Switch it on with the instance's Telemetry entry (telemetry-relay addon), which reserves the server ID; each feed is a separate switch below.

plugins.label: stream_telemetry_unified helper
plugins.description: Helper of stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: stream_telemetry_unified helper
plugins.description: Helper of stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Referee Call
plugins.description: Adds !call, which lets any player or spectator ask for a referee, once per 60 seconds. The call reaches the referees through stream_telemetry_unified, which needs Session Events (qlx_statsHubFeedSession) on.

plugins.label: Tournament Match Notice
plugins.description: Says in chat and on screen that the players here have a tournament match: when both players of a ready or live match are on the server, in warmup only, once per map. The site is asked in the background only when the players change; a failure just skips the notice.

plugins.label: QLMatch Packer
plugins.description: Builds a .qlmatch pack and its .replay.json.gz when the engine finishes a match's demos, by running the qlmatch-packer addon's pack.mjs. Needs the qlmatch-packer addon and the minqlxtended fork with native demo capture, sv_demoRecord 1 and sv_demoCut 1.

plugins.label: qlmatch_packer helper
plugins.description: Helper of qlmatch_packer.py, downloaded with it. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Demo Stream Resync Hold
plugins.description: Keeps a live demo stream decodable after a resync by forcing full snapshots for a streamed player until the client acknowledges one. Off by default (measured on a duel server only); needs sv_demoStream on and the minqlxtended fork with the live demo stream.

plugins.label: Frame Timing
plugins.description: Writes server frame timing (late frames, max, p50 and p99 gap over the last 10 seconds) to Redis every 10 seconds for the host-metrics addon. No commands and no settings.

plugins.label: Item Roulette
plugins.description: Every pickup is a coin flip: the item gives what it always gives, or takes instead - armor, health and ammo go down, a weapon is lost, a powerup turns into a curse of the same length. What each item gives and takes is configurable.

plugins.label: Gun Game
plugins.description: FFA Gun Game: every frag moves the killer one weapon down a configurable ladder, a frag on the last step wins the match. Map weapons and powerups are removed, the instance needs g_infiniteAmmo 1.

plugins.label: Mod HUD helper
plugins.description: Helper of plugins that use the mod HUD panel, downloaded with them. Not a plugin.

plugins.label: Mod HUD
plugins.description: Writes the shared mod HUD panel (three lines with icons, players need zz_modhud.pk3) from chat: !hud sets a line for everyone, !hudicons lists the icon tokens. Other plugins (Gun Game) draw on the panel without this one.

plugins.label: NPC core
plugins.description: Helper of tower_defence: server entities as creeps and turrets, missiles, CS_MODELS and CS_ITEMS registration. Not a plugin of its own.

plugins.label: Tower defence rules
plugins.description: Helper of tower_defence: tables, waves, money and pads, no engine calls. Not a plugin of its own.

plugins.label: Tower defence
plugins.description: Cooperative tower defence on a map with td_* markers: 15 waves of entity creeps, turrets on pads for team money, 20 base lives. Other maps are untouched. The game runs in warmup. The instance needs g_teamForceBalance 0, g_friendlyFire 0, g_infiniteAmmo 1 and g_teamSizeMin 1.

addons.label: Demos
addons.description: Adds a Demos screen to each instance that lists its recorded demos grouped by match, with filters and downloads. Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer; install qlmatch-packer as well to see and rebuild .qlmatch packs.

addons.label: Live Demo Stream
addons.description: Streams players' views live from an instance to ql-stats-hub through a central relay, over a TLS tunnel on each host. Has no menu entries of its own: the stream, its delay, the host tunnel and the relay are set in the Stats Hub entries of the Telemetry Relay addon (1.9.0 or newer), next to telemetry. Needs a game server with the sv_demoStream cvars.

addons.label: File Forwarder
addons.description: Ships demo files from every game host to the site VPS over SFTP every few minutes and deletes delivered raw demos from the host after the retention period. Needs the VPS address saved in Settings (its host keys are scanned then) and the install's SFTP public key added to the VPS once.

addons.label: Host Metrics
addons.description: CPU, memory, disk and per-instance load of every game host, with a capacity verdict.

addons.label: Live Settings
addons.description: Adds a Live Settings tab to each instance's Edit Configuration window: the cvars of its plugins and any server cvars you pin, with the live value from the running server next to the server.cfg value. Changes go to the server over RCON at once, no restart, and are written to server.cfg too unless you untick that. Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer.

addons.label: Player Ranks
addons.description: Shows each connected player's rating from qlstats, Slipgate and x76 in one Rank column in Live Status, with the sources chosen per instance on its Ranks tab. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer; qlstats and Slipgate are set up once in Settings, x76 per instance.

addons.label: Qlmatch Packer
addons.description: Installs the qlmatch packer and Node.js 22 on every game host at host setup and Update Plugins, and shows and rebuilds .qlmatch packs and replay files on the Demos screen. The qlmatch_packer plugin runs the packer when the engine finishes a match's demos; needs the demo-management addon.

addons.label: Runtime Source
addons.description: Builds a host's minqlxtended from a repository you choose instead of the commit QLSM pins, for example the fork native demo capture needs. Set the repository and commit in the host's Runtime Source entry, then Re-run Host Setup; needs a QLSM with the host.setup hook.

addons.label: Server Ping
addons.description: Browser ping to game hosts: deploys ql-ping-echo (a low-priority WebRTC UDP echo, one shared DTLS certificate) to each enabled host and opens its UDP port in its own firewall chain QLPING-INPUT.

addons.label: Telemetry Relay
addons.description: Sends live telemetry (positions, item pickups, match events) from game instances to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host, and owns the Stats Hub entries: one host entry, one instance entry and one settings section for telemetry and the live demo stream (the stream itself needs the Live Demo Stream addon 1.9.0 or newer). Needs the stream_telemetry_unified plugin on the instances.
